title: Midday Hydration Catch-Up Alert
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hydration:intake
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour<13
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(ml) as ml_by_midday by _time
| eval catch_up_needed=if(ml_by_midday<1000,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Flags days where hydration is already lagging by lunchtime.
value: A midday catch-up alert is more useful than an end-of-day total because it still leaves time to fix the habit.
implementation: Send water-intake logs to `index=personal`; alert when cumulative intake by midday misses your threshold.
visualization: Daily column chart of hydration reached by midday.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when you are already behind on water by lunchtime, so there is still time to catch up the easy way.
